additional_sources.title: Anasuria Operating Company: Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report explicitly states 2024 Anasuria FPSO UK ETS CO2 emissions of 105,850.9819 tonnes (rounded narrative 105,851). Offshore facility value cannot become an England cadastral parcel.

additional_sources.title: INEOS FPS: Environmental Public Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official report explicitly states Scope 1 CO2e values for Kinneil 158.8 ktCO2e, RLPG 41.9 ktCO2e and Unity 0.29 ktCO2e. Kinneil/RLPG are Scotland onshore and Unity is offshore; none is an England cadastral parcel.

additional_sources.title: Apache Corporation North Sea: 2024 EMS Annual Performance Report
additional_sources.guard: Air-emissions report exposes 2024 installation source-stream quantities, but table headings mix flaring and fuel/diesel usage. No GHG quantity row is promoted without unambiguous pollutant-unit semantics.

additional_sources.title: Dana Petroleum: Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official report graph shows 2020-2024 Triton/Western Isles atmospheric emissions. Screenshot confirms graph presence but bars lack printed exact 2024 values; zero axis interpolation.

additional_sources.title: bp North Sea: Annual Environment Report 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED collection report retained as a high-value measurement surface. Current tool text extraction and screenshots did not expose a reliable explicit row; no numeric promotion.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Explicit facility or portfolio scope, gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance are required. Offshore or non-England values cannot become England cadastral parcels.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Graph-only, ambiguous-layout, raw fuel-use or inaccessible values cannot become measured GHG rows without explicit printed quantity and compatible scope.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED collection and government-hosted PDF research on 2026-07-27. Anasuria and INEOS FPS expose explicit numeric GHG values; Dana graph was screenshot-verified without interpolation; Apache usage semantics were withheld; bp screenshots cache-missed. Existing Ithaca source was re-read and its explicit 448,190 tCO2e 2024 operated Scope 1+2 total is promoted as a new row without double-counting the source.
